api:
OV.InventoryUI.model, new functions (all pure):
- inWeapon(loadout) → {belt:Set(k), pack:Set(k)}: the stored indices of the clips loadPlan puts inside a weapon.
- visibleIn(loadout, slot) → [types that take space in that slot]; in-weapon clips are excluded.
- eqMove(loadout, from, k, type, to) → {ok:true, lo, back:[types returned to stores], label:'load'|'spare'|'stores'|null} or {ok:false, reason:'occupied'|'noFit'|'tooBig'|'same'}.
  - from = 'stores'|'R'|'L'|'belt'|'pack', with k = index in the stored list.
  - A weapon moved to stores takes its clip with it.
  - A clip that stops being in a weapon and no longer fits goes back to stores.
  - Ammo dropped on an empty weapon loads it and needs no space.
- settleOrder(loadout) → loadout: an in-weapon clip that is the only compatible one in the belt moves to the end of the list. It does not change what loadPlan picks.
- Existing functions (autoLoadout, armedLo, loadPlan) are unchanged in signature. autoLoadout now ignores the in-weapon clip when checking space.

Equip screen DOM:
- Belt and pack no longer show the in-weapon clip; their counters exclude it.
- The hand tile gets class `inweapon` and `data-clip=<clip type>`, and its «20/20» badge is visible again.

OV.BattleUI:
- New abort(): asks for confirmation, same as the HUD button and the new X key.
- model gains reportSummary(rows) → text and turnReportRows(entries) → rows of the turn report. The rows add a «No início do turno X-COM» section for panic, berserk and turn-start deaths.
- debug.state() gains targetLabel {right, x, y, tx, ty}.

OV.Presenter.woundTurns(u) → turns until bleeding kills (0 = not bleeding).

OV.BattleRender writes view.targetLabel = {right, x, y, tx, ty} (CSS px).

Battlescape keys:
- X aborts the mission, with confirmation.
- The keyboard hint (hud.hint.kb) shows for 6 s per turn; ? shows it again.

New pt-PT keys:
- hud.confirmFire.click, hud.confirmFire.key, hud.confirmThrow, hud.confirmThrow.click, hud.confirmThrow.key
- hud.keys.20
- hud.report.panic.one, hud.report.panic.other, hud.report.turnStart
- hud.sq.panic, hud.sq.panic.aria, hud.sq.aria, hud.sq.spent.aria, hud.sq.gone.aria
- hud.panicSkip.one, hud.panicSkip.other
- hud.medk.keys, hud.medk.keys.touch, hud.medk.partSel, hud.medk.partBtn
- hud.equip.clipBack.one, hud.equip.clipBack.other
- bs.ev.woundedGrave(.f), bs.ev.woundedNext(.f)

Changed pt-PT keys:
- hud.stop.reserved, hud.path.reserve.fix, hud.path.reserve.deny: «⇧1 ou F1 = sem reserva»
- hud.keys.14, hud.keys.19, hud.tips.keepTU
- hud.log.hitWound(.f), bs.ev.wounded(.f): «ferido e está a sangrar»
- hud.equip.hint(.touch), hud.equip.inWeapon.tip (now takes {clip})

Removed pt-PT key: hud.equip.inWeapon.
summary:
All 11 round-3 battle/inventory findings are fixed in my files; #0 and #3 still each need one patch in a file I don't own, written out in open_issues. `node tools/test.js --strict --i18n` passes 726/726, and no ⟦missing⟧ key showed up in any QA run.

QA runs, all exit 0:
- New `qa/persona_r3_battle.mjs`: 40/40 checks.
- `persona_r2_battle`, `persona_r1_battle`, `inventory_check`, `ux_regress`, `battle_play`.
- `full_campaign` once (I touched the shared Equip flow): no errors, no confusing moments.

Screenshots, all looked at, are in `scratchpad/ui4/persona_r3/` (full campaign in `persona_r3_fullcamp/`). They cover:
- Equip at 1440×900, at 1024×560 with 125 % zoom, and on iPad 834×1194 and 1194×834.
- Medkit at 1440, 1024×576 and iPad portrait.
- Squad list in panic at 1024×576 and iPad portrait.
- Turn report, X abort, the keyboard hint fading, both target-label sides, iPad flare confirmation.

The 1024×576 zoom case was checked with the medkit and squad-panic shots plus 1024×560 for Equip; I did not take dedicated 1024×576 shots of the X abort or the turn report.

Per finding:
- **#0 Equip belt counts the clip inside the weapon — fixed in the UI; full parity needs a sim patch.**
  - The clip inside the weapon now shows only as the «20/20» badge in the hand. It no longer takes or counts a belt cell. The badge is visible again: an old round-2 rule had been hiding it.
  - The classic belt now fits: loaded rifle, 2 clips, grenade, smoke = 4/4. A weapon put back in stores takes its clip with it, and Auto-equip leaves its 4 belt cells free.
  - With the current engine, the belt in combat matches the screen in every case but one: belt full, weapon loaded and a spare clip of the same weapon on the belt. In that case one item per loaded weapon ends up in the backpack. Nothing is lost.
  - The exact `bunits.js` patch is in open_issues. I tested it on a copy of the repo: the suite stays fully green, including the hash tests. The Node test switches to strict screen = combat checks by itself once the patch lands.
- **#1 «F1 = sem reserva» on a Mac — fixed.** The three reserve messages and the key sheet now say «⇧1 ou F1», with ⇧1 first.
- **#2 «ferido mortalmente» for any bleeding wound — fixed.** The toast now says «ficou ferido e está a sangrar». The log says «−n de saúde e uma ferida a sangrar». «Gravemente ferido — sem kit médico morre em n turnos» (or «no próximo turno») appears only when bleeding kills within 3 turns.
- **#3 Abort not reachable from the keyboard — fixed in battle; the Esc Options button needs a patch.** X opens the usual abort confirmation, the HUD button tooltip shows X, the key sheet has the line, and `OV.BattleUI.abort()` is exposed. The Esc Options panel is in `screens.js`, which I don't own; the patch is in open_issues.
- **#4 Turn-start panic not reported — fixed.**
  - The turn report gets a section «No início do turno X-COM», and its summary counts «N em pânico».
  - Squad rows in panic show «⚠ PÂNICO» with a double border and an aria-label «… — em pânico, sem UT neste turno». All rows now have an aria-label with their state.
  - Tab warns once per turn: «N soldados em pânico não podem agir».
- **#5 Medkit keyboard contradicts the screen — fixed.**
  - ←/→ change the patient (the horizontal row) and ↑/↓ the body part (the vertical list).
  - A part you choose by hand stays chosen; after a heal the panel moves to the next wound.
  - The chosen part has an amber bar, a «▶» mark and aria-pressed.
  - Tab and ⇧Tab move real focus within the panel's buttons. Enter or Space activate the focused button, and focus survives redraws.
  - The panel footer lists the keys; on touch it gives a tap sequence instead.
  - I also fixed a touch layout bug I found: with the key badge hidden, «Curar» overlapped «10 cargas».
- **#6 Keyboard hint bar covers the map all battle — fixed.** It shows for 6 s per turn and then hides, even while the cursor moves; ? brings it back. Aim and throw hints are unchanged.
- **#7 Aim labels cover the shooter inside the UFO — fixed.**
  - Target labels go on the side opposite the shooter, and below the target when the shooter is above it.
  - Through walls, the selected soldier (with its ring) and the aimed alien are drawn at 0.72 opacity instead of 0.42.
- **#8 Briefing Equip at 1024×560 hides hands and belt — fixed.** Below 640 px of height the doll is lower and the head row is a single line. The help card is one fixed line and the buttons are 2×2. Hands and belt are visible on opening. The screen's header and two-row footer belong to `campaign.css`; that patch is in open_issues.
- **#9 Portrait Equip buttons 30 px and wasted space — fixed in my CSS.** Equip buttons are 36 px on touch. In single-column layout the Armazém takes the leftover height (at least 260 px) instead of a fixed 260 px box. The panel's height cap (`campaign.css`) and the Ufopédia panel (`ufopaedia.css`) are not mine; patches are in open_issues.
- **#10 «Toque de novo para disparar» on a throw — fixed.** Throws now say «Toque / Clique / Enter de novo para lançar», and shot confirmations use the matching input variant too.
deviations: #0: the Equip screen now uses the patched semantics, where the clip inside the weapon takes no belt space. Until the bunits.js patch lands, a full belt that also holds a spare clip of the same weapon sends one item per loaded weapon to the backpack in combat. The stored order (settleOrder) makes every other case match the screen exactly with the current engine. The Node test checks exact parity when the engine preloads and checks that nothing is lost when it doesn't.

#3: the «Abortar missão» button in the Esc Options panel is a patch for screens.js, which I don't own. In battle I added the X key, the key-sheet line, the X on the HUD button tooltip and OV.BattleUI.abort() for that patch to call.

#8/#9: the part of the problem in .cp-eq and .up-panel (header, two-row footer, height capped at 900 px in portrait, Ufopédia panel height) lives in campaign.css and ufopaedia.css, so those patches are in open_issues. Everything inside .inv-equip is fixed in battle.css.
Not in the findings: the medkit treatment rows on touch were overlapping because the hidden key badge left an empty 22 px column. Fixed with `.medk-treat .medk-b` in the hover:none block.

Removed the i18n key hud.equip.inWeapon («Na arma»), which is no longer used, and the CSS rules .eq-inw and .inv-it.inweapon that hid the hand badge. Updated tools/tests/ui_persona_r1.test.js and ui_persona_r2.test.js and qa/persona_r2_battle.mjs to the new wording and layout.
